_comment: Sample list, committed so the tool runs out of the box. Keep your real dates in reminders.local.json (gitignored) or in a REMINDERS_JSON repo secret.

reminders.label: Rent transfer
reminders.notes: Standing order, but check it actually left the account.

reminders.label: Laptop warranty ends
reminders.notes: Raise the keyboard fault before this date or pay for it.

reminders.label: Gym membership renews
reminders.notes: Cancel by the 11th if it is still going unused.

reminders.label: Visa paperwork
reminders.notes: Details stay out of the public agenda; category only.

reminders.label: Passport expires
reminders.notes: Renew at nine months left; some countries want six months of validity.
